title: B.Cave drops a new single "Young Soprano"
htmlContent:
B.Cave has delivered a new track "Young Soprano," a major record that carries the excitement people love in their music. The art and magic of music is on full bloom for every second, as you get to explore the daring sound they create, to make something beyond words, for a supreme display of music.

The single "Young Soprano" is An upbeat, east coast hip-hop style song with a catchy hook and strong lyricism within the verse. Accompanied by an incredibly cinematic music video, that plays more like a short film than anything. This is the first single off of B.Cave's upcoming 7-track EP called 'Sojourner.'
